reason: Independent shadow layers in ki-select, ki-alert, ki-tooltip, ki-status and ki-video (#349 and spec 025 S13). Adds the semantic --ki-effect-video-hover-opacity token so Material 3 retains the flat play control on hover. The token build emits a transparent layer (0 0 #0000) for the Material 3 --ki-video-play-shadow value previously emitted as none. Both values prevent the resting shadow from painting. Supersedes 317-321-loading-hint-touch and retains all changes declared there and in its predecessors. The cumulative delta against 0.0.0 remains major. It supersedes 345-switch-glyph-tokens and carries forward its declared changes.
